title: EPA Water Quality Record
description: Schema for EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) public water system sample results and violations

system_id.description: Public Water System (PWS) identifier assigned by EPA

system_name.description: Name of the public water system

system_type.description: Classification of the public water system

sample_date.description: Date the water sample was collected

contaminant.description: Name of the contaminant tested in the sample

contaminant_code.description: EPA numeric code identifying the contaminant

result_value.description: Measured concentration of the contaminant in the sample

unit.description: Unit of measure for the result value

mcl.description: Maximum Contaminant Level set by EPA for this contaminant

mcl_violation.description: True if result_value exceeds the MCL threshold

violation_type.description: Category of regulatory violation if one occurred

state_code.description: Two-digit FIPS state code where the system operates

county_served.description: County or counties served by this public water system

population_served.description: Estimated population served by the public water system

source_type.description: Origin of the water supply for this system

primacy_agency.description: State or tribal agency with primary enforcement authority

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the pipeline

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the lakehouse

_source.description: Source system or API identifier for this record

_batch_id.description: Batch job identifier that produced this record
